name: dbt job - Support for dbt Fusion runtime in dbt job
description: We are adding support **dbt Fusion runtime** in dbt job in Microsoft Fabric as an execution environment, in addition to the existing dbt Core–based runtime.Customers can select the Fusion runtime when creating or configuring a dbt job to run their transformations on the next-generation dbt engine — natively inside Fabric, with no local tooling or external orchestration to manage.
